comparison.objective: Refit a rack-server air shroud by inserting both front tabs under the fan cage and lowering the rear to seat.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handling of a large rigid duct, simultaneous dual-tab insertion, constrained lowering, and release among obstacles.
comparison.success_condition: Both tabs extend at least 3 mm into their slots, all four shroud corners lie within 2 mm of the chassis floor, grippers clear by 3 cm, and the shroud remains still for one second.
comparison.reason: This tests large-part dual-tab insertion and seating in a server chassis, with no threaded tool use, countertorque regulation, or retained angular-stop calibration.
